model: 15 geriatric-appropriate actives. The box is the user's whole protocol: an active they already take is KEPT in the box when it serves a goal they picked and is on our shelf, rather than deduped out. Differentiation comes from the condition rules, not from riskier ingredients. Two higher-risk botanicals are hard-gated (auto-excluded) for their risk groups, then substituted or the protocol shortens.

product.format: one mixed sachet per day (pills + capsules)

cap_unit: two ceilings apply, whichever binds first: max_supplements is the number of distinct actives in the box; default_pill_cap and the age-band pill_cap are PHYSICAL PILLS per day (sum of units_per_day)
